summary: Backend and frontend changes largely implement custom-domain persistence and Admin Domain tab integration. The backend adds a persistent `customDomain : ?Text` with query/get and admin-gated set, plus a migration module. The Admin page uses existing domain normalization/validation and attempts to persist via new hooks with success/error toasts. One acceptance criterion appears unmet: there is no explicit way to clear/unset the saved custom domain.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes an admin-only update method to set/clear the custom domain.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows only `setCustomDomain(domain : Text)` which always sets `customDomain := ?domain` and provides no method/parameter path to clear it back to `null` (unset).
